claims.statement: [[PrivateRegulatoryPower]] and [[AIAlignmentGovernance]] show that governance questions arise inside firms and technical organizations as well as through public law.

summary: Governance is presented as enforceable control over incentives, information, rights, and accountability; stronger institutional capacity can produce order while also creating backlash, concentrated power, or new legitimacy problems.
